newsitem.title: USA: "Absolute Power" tops video rental list.
newsitem.headline: "Absolute Power" tops video rental list.

text.p: "Absolute Power,' which stars and was directed by Clint Eastwood, moved to the number one spot on the top ten renting videos for the week ended July 20 from the second position a week earlier, according to the Video Software Dealers Association.

The top 10 video rentals, with label and earnings, were: "Absolute Power" (Warner), $3.2 million; "Scream (Buena Vista), $2.7 million; "Metro," (Buena Vista), $2.7 million; "Michael" (Warner) $2.3 million; "National Lampoon's Vegas Vacation" (Warner) $2 million; "Jerry Maguire" (Columbia TriStar), $1.8 million; "Beverly Hills Ninja" (Columbia TriStar) $1.7 million; "The Relic" (Paramount) $1.6 million; "Turbulence" (Warner) $1.3 million; "My Fellow Americans" (Warner), $1.3 million.
Warner is a unit of Time Warner Inc ; Buena Vista is a unit of Walt Disney Co ; Columbia-TriStar is a unit of Sony Corp ; and Paramount is a unit of Viacom Inc.
The Video Software Dealers Association is a trade group for video rental stores in the U.S.
